verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an AI research-notebook product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a self-hosted, on-premises, or downloadable deployment. The docs describe only a Google-hosted service, a core Workspace service integrated into the Gemini web page. Offline audio downloads and exports to Docs/Sheets are data-portability features, not self-hosting of the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
